releases.notes:
##  additions
- [[#16](https://github.com/eggomods/kaya/pull/16)] added int/float provider types related to player experience:
  - `player/xp/progress` (float)
  - `player/xp/level` (int)
  - `player/xp/next` (int)
  - `player/xp/score` (int)
- [[#23](https://github.com/eggomods/kaya/pull/23)] added `callback/vibration/listened` power type
- [[#25](https://github.com/eggomods/kaya/pull/25)] added math-related float/vec3 provider types
  - `normalize` (vec3)
  - `cross_product` (vec3)
  - `reverse` (vec3)
  - `product` (vec3) (aliases: `mul`, `multiply`)
  - `linear_interpolated` (vec3) (aliases: `lerp`)
  - `sum` (vec3) (aliases: `add`, `addition`)
  - `difference` (vec3) (aliases: `sub`, `diff`, `subtract`)
  - `rotate` (vec3)
  - `dot_product` (float)
- [[#30](https://github.com/eggomods/kaya/pull/30)] added more math-related float provider types
  - `arc/cosine` (aliases: `acos`)
  - `arc/sine` (aliases: `asin`)
  - `cosine` (aliases: `cos`)
  - `sine` (aliases: `sin`)
  - `square_root/inverse` (aliases: `inv_sqrt`)
  - `square_root` (aliases: `sqrt`)
  - `tangent/arc/2` (aliases: `atan2`)
  - `tangent` (aliases: `tan`)
  - `tangent/arc` (aliases: `atan`)
  - `to_degrees`
  - `to_radians`
- added float provider types for entity pitch/yaw
  - `entity/pitch`
  - `entity/yaw`
- added `from_slot` item provider type
- added an optional `entity` entity provider field to `blocks_colliding_box` int provider type (to accommodate the removal of the `BoxProvider#getCollisionContext` method)
- re-added `command_result` number provider type as an int provider type, which was mistakenly removed when Kaya's number providers were split into float/int providers

##  fixes
- fixed `modify/player/spawn` power type sometimes putting the player on the ceiling of a dimension that has one (e.g: the Nether)
- fixed incorrect logic for checking if an output log is already displayed (for output logs that are only supposed to be displayed once)
- fixed `key/pressed_ticks` int provider type still providing the computed result even if the pressed time of the specified key is not zero

##  changes

### for users
- renamed `entity` and `block` slot provider types to `from_entity` and `from_block` respectively (the old paths will be used as aliases, but they may be removed in a subsequent or future version)
- the `equipped_enchantment_level` int provider type can now accept a set of enchantment IDs/tags in its `enchantment` field

### for developers
- [[#28](https://github.com/eggomods/kaya/pull/28)] refactored how dependencies of managers are handled
- powers now have `Properties` which stores the power's name, description, hidden flag, and active condition. to migrate, replace the `Optional<Condition>` with `Properties`, and place it at the very end (convention)
- added a new service, `KayaServices#MANAGERS`, for storing all the managers instead of having individual services for each manager
- added a helper method for easily enabling a rudimentary version handshake for a certain mod ID
- removed `BoxProvider#getCollisionContext` method to reduce ambiguity in scenarios where an explicit collision context is needed
